name: Login page displays required fields and Sign In button is disabled until both fields are filled
objective: Verifies AC-1, AC-2, AC-3: Login page displays required fields and Sign In button is disabled until both fields are filled

testSteps.description: the user navigates to "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"
testSteps.expectedResult: the Email field, Password field, 'Remember me for 30 days' checkbox, and Sign In button are displayed

testSteps.description: the user views the Sign In button with both Email and Password fields empty
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is disabled

testSteps.description: the user enters a value in the Email field and leaves the Password field empty
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is disabled

testSteps.description: the user enters a value in both the Email field and the Password field
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is enabled

name: Valid credentials redirect to Dashboard and profile button displays character B
objective: Verifies AC-4, AC-5: Valid credentials redirect to Dashboard and profile button displays character B
precondition: the user is on the login page at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"

testSteps.description: the user is on the login page at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"
testSteps.expectedResult: the Email field, Password field, and Sign In button are displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters "{{validEmail}}" in the Email field and "{{validPassword}}" in the Password field and clicks Sign In
testSteps.expectedResult: the user is redirected to "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/" and the page displays the header 'Dashboard'

testSteps.description: the user views the top-left corner of the Dashboard
testSteps.expectedResult: a profile button displaying the character 'B' is visible

name: Opening My Profile modal shows pre-populated editable fields and Change Password section
objective: Verifies AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10, AC-11, AC-12: Opening My Profile modal shows pre-populated editable fields and Change Password section
precondition: the user is authenticated and on the Dashboard at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/"

testSteps.description: the user is authenticated and on the Dashboard at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/"
testSteps.expectedResult: the Dashboard header is displayed

testSteps.description: the user clicks the profile button at the top-left corner
testSteps.expectedResult: the user menu is displayed containing the user initial, the email '{{validEmail}}', a 'Profile' option, and a 'Logout' option

testSteps.description: the user clicks the 'Profile' option in the user menu
testSteps.expectedResult: the My Profile modal opens displaying the title 'My Profile' and the description 'View and edit your account information.'

testSteps.description: the user views the fields in the My Profile modal
testSteps.expectedResult:
the Name, Email, and Phone fields are displayed pre-populated with the user's current account information and are editable
the 'Change Password' section is displayed with a 'New Password' input field and a 'Confirm Password' input field
a Close (X) button is visible in the top-right corner of the modal

name: Saving profile with blank password fields preserves existing password and reflects updated info
objective: Verifies AC-13, AC-16, AC-17, BR-2: Saving profile with blank password fields preserves existing password and reflects updated info
precondition: the user has the My Profile modal open

testSteps.description: the user has the My Profile modal open
testSteps.expectedResult: the Name, Email, Phone, New Password, and Confirm Password fields are displayed

testSteps.description: the user updates the Name field with {{updatedName}} and leaves New Password and Confirm Password blank and clicks 'Save Changes'
testSteps.expectedResult: the profile changes are saved and the existing password is preserved unchanged

testSteps.description: the user closes and reopens the My Profile modal
testSteps.expectedResult: the Name field displays {{updatedName}} reflecting the updated profile information

name: Saving profile with matching non-empty passwords accepts the new password
objective: Verifies AC-15, AC-16, BR-3: Saving profile with matching non-empty passwords accepts the new password
precondition: the user has the My Profile modal open

testSteps.description: the user has the My Profile modal open
testSteps.expectedResult: the New Password and Confirm Password fields are displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters {{newPassword}} in the New Password field and {{newPassword}} in the Confirm Password field and clicks 'Save Changes'
testSteps.expectedResult: password validation passes and the updated profile information is saved successfully

name: Mismatched New Password and Confirm Password values reject the save with a mismatch error
objective: Verifies AC-14, AC-26, BR-3, BR-4: Mismatched New Password and Confirm Password values reject the save with a mismatch error
precondition: the user has the My Profile modal open

testSteps.description: the user has the My Profile modal open
testSteps.expectedResult: the New Password and Confirm Password fields are displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters {{newPassword}} in the New Password field and {{differentPassword}} in the Confirm Password field and clicks 'Save Changes'
testSteps.expectedResult: the save is rejected and a password mismatch error is indicated before any profile changes are persisted

name: Sign In button remains disabled when only the Email field contains a value
objective: Verifies AC-2, BR-1: Sign In button remains disabled when only the Email field contains a value
precondition: the user is on the login page at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"

testSteps.description: the user is on the login page at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"
testSteps.expectedResult: the Email field and Password field are displayed and both are empty

testSteps.description: the user enters "{{validEmail}}" in the Email field and leaves the Password field empty
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is disabled

name: Sign In button remains disabled when only the Password field contains a value
objective: Verifies AC-2, BR-1: Sign In button remains disabled when only the Password field contains a value
precondition: the user is on the login page at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"

testSteps.description: the user is on the login page at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"
testSteps.expectedResult: the Email field and Password field are displayed and both are empty

testSteps.description: the user leaves the Email field empty and enters "{{validPassword}}" in the Password field
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is disabled

name: Clicking Cancel discards unsaved changes and closes the modal leaving the user on the Dashboard
objective: Verifies AC-18, BR-5: Clicking Cancel discards unsaved changes and closes the modal leaving the user on the Dashboard
precondition: the user has the My Profile modal open with unsaved changes entered in the Name field

testSteps.description: the user has the My Profile modal open with unsaved changes entered in the Name field
testSteps.expectedResult: the modal is displayed with the unsaved changes visible

testSteps.description: the user clicks 'Cancel'
testSteps.expectedResult: the My Profile modal is closed, the unsaved changes are discarded, and the Dashboard is displayed

name: Sign In button becomes enabled when each field contains exactly one character
objective: Verifies AC-3, BR-1: Sign In button becomes enabled when each field contains exactly one character
precondition: the user is on the login page at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"

testSteps.description: the user is on the login page at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/login"
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is disabled with both fields empty

testSteps.description: the user enters a single character in the Email field and a single character in the Password field
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is enabled

name: Clicking the Close X button on the My Profile modal closes the modal
objective: Verifies AC-9: Clicking the Close X button on the My Profile modal closes the modal
precondition: the user has the My Profile modal open

testSteps.description: the user has the My Profile modal open
testSteps.expectedResult: the Close (X) button is visible in the top-right corner of the modal

testSteps.description: the user clicks the Close (X) button
testSteps.expectedResult: the My Profile modal is closed and the Dashboard is displayed

name: My Profile modal and user menu display exact UI text and profile button shows correct tooltip
objective: Verifies AC-19, AC-20, AC-21, AC-22, AC-23, AC-24, AC-25: My Profile modal and user menu display exact UI text and profile button shows correct tooltip
precondition: the user is authenticated and on the Dashboard at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/"

testSteps.description: the user is authenticated and on the Dashboard at "https://admin.nexolvi.ai/"
testSteps.expectedResult: the profile button at the top-left displays the character 'B'

testSteps.description: the user hovers over the profile button
testSteps.expectedResult: a native browser tooltip displaying 'bikash.h' is shown

testSteps.description: the user clicks the profile button
testSteps.expectedResult: the user menu displays the full name 'Bikash h', email '{{validEmail}}', a 'Profile' button, and a 'Logout' button

testSteps.description: the user clicks the 'Profile' option and views the My Profile modal
testSteps.expectedResult:
the modal header text is exactly 'My Profile' and the description text is exactly 'View and edit your account information.'
the New Password field displays the placeholder text 'Leave blank to keep current'
the Confirm Password field displays the placeholder text 'Repeat new password'

name: New Password and Confirm Password fields mask entered characters
objective: Verifies AC-27: New Password and Confirm Password fields mask entered characters
precondition: the user has the My Profile modal open

testSteps.description: the user has the My Profile modal open
testSteps.expectedResult: the 'Change Password' section with New Password and Confirm Password fields is displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters {{newPassword}} in the New Password field and {{newPassword}} in the Confirm Password field
testSteps.expectedResult:
the characters entered in the New Password field are masked
the characters entered in the Confirm Password field are masked
